card: Suppresses echoing user-supplied passwords in plain-text terminal output from `share/rpcauth/rpcauth.py`. Previously, passwords supplied via positional arguments or hidden prompts were printed back to standard output, unnecessarily exposing credentials to terminal scrollback. Passwords generated by the tool continue to be displayed, and machine-readable JSON output remains unchanged.
evidence: Author description: "Printing a user-supplied password again exposes a secret without any benefit. This is especially unnecessary in `getpass` mode: the password is entered hidden, then printed to the screen."
problem: `rpcauth.py` prints user-supplied passwords back to the terminal in plain text. When users input a password via a hidden interactive prompt (`-`), the utility immediately prints the secret back to the screen, exposing it to scrollback and shoulder surfing without benefit.

risk.why: A bug would only affect the auxiliary rpcauth credential generation script or its functional test.

summary: Updates `share/rpcauth/rpcauth.py` to stop echoing user-supplied passwords in plain-text output, printing the password only when it was generated by the script itself. JSON output formatting remains unchanged, and unit coverage is added to `test/functional/tool_rpcauth.py` to verify output across input modes.
